exam_scheme.note: SBI Junior Associates recruitment is a 2-stage competitive online examination followed by a qualifying Local Language Test for candidates without local language credentials in 10th/12th standard. There is no interview for clerical recruitment.

papers.paper_name: Test of Specified Opted Local Language (Reading, Writing, Speaking)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Exempt if 10th/12th mark sheet indicates local language studied; otherwise mandatory qualifying

financial_package.pay_source_label: SBI Junior Associates Recruitment Advertisement and 12th Bipartite Settlement (Scale: ₹24,050-64,480)
financial_package.estimate_note: Starting basic pay is ₹24,050 in the scale ₹24,050 - 1340/3 - 28,070 - 1650/3 - 33,020 - 2000/4 - 41,020 - 2340/7 - 57,400 - 4400/1 - 61,800 - 2680/1 - 64,480 under the 12th Bipartite Settlement. Candidates with graduation join with two advance increments (effective basic pay of ₹26,730). Total gross emoluments at metro centres reach approx. ₹46,000 per month inclusive of DA at 58% review baseline, HRA, Transport Allowance, and Special Allowance.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) or leased residential quarters where applicable
Medical aid and hospitalization coverage for self and eligible dependent family members
Leave Fare Concession (LFC) / Home Travel Concession once in two years
Monthly Conveyance Allowance / Local Travel Reimbursement
Concessional Staff Loans for Housing, Car/Two-Wheeler, and Personal Loans
Defined Contributory Pension Scheme under National Pension System (NPS)

competition_benchmarks.note: SBI Clerk attracts among the largest applicant pools nationally for public sector clerical employment.
